copy.draftEvidenceRecheckCannotHelpOriginal: The visual evidence for these {count} photos cannot be filled in locally: the original is not on this machine, the original has been replaced, or which image was looked at was never recorded. Recomputing still leaves them out; giving them visual evidence means asking the model again.

copy.draftEvidenceRevisionStale: The tiers above were computed against version {then} of this draft, now version {now}: it changed in between and the tiers were not recomputed.
copy.draftEvidenceRecheckHint: Recomputing only re-checks the observations already stored on this machine against the preview files as they are now. It does not ask the model again and does not upload photos.
copy.draftEvidenceRecheckDone: Recomputed; the tiers now record this version.
copy.draftEvidenceRecheckUnchanged: Recomputed, and the result is the same as before: the visual records for those {count} photos still cannot be used. Computing again gives the same numbers — repair their local previews and recompute once more before expecting a change; any photo whose original has itself been replaced, or whose original is not on this machine, cannot be brought back by repairing, and asking the model again is the only way.
copy.draftEvidenceRecheckCannotHelp: The visual records for these {count} photos never recorded which image was looked at. That cannot be filled in locally, so recomputing still leaves them out; giving them visual evidence means asking the model again.
copy.draftEvidenceMissing: This proposal has no visual basis that can be checked here, so the notes below rest on ratings, status and order only.
